summary: Iteration 10 — Full regression on the new WAF-lite security layer (backend/security.py) without touching the account system. Backend: 11/11 WAF tests pass via loopback (test_waf_security.py) covering legit traffic, probe path blocking (/api/.env, /wp-admin → 403), scanner UA (sqlmap/1.7 → 403), XSS/SQLi/traversal in query → 400, 2MB body on /api/contact → 413, legit special chars (Gută & Manuel) → 200, admin security endpoint auth-gated, comments 10/min rate limit → 429, security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS, X-Robots-Tag, CSP, Server without versions). 9/9 batch9 auth-hardening tests still pass (test_batch9_hardening.py): /api/auth/me + /api/fans/me unauth → 200 {user:null}, no-store+noindex on /api/auth/*, admin login+cookie, TV schedule CRUD with day_of_week, admin schedule auth-guard, fan register bad-email, fan 5-fail lockout 429, strict auth 10 POST/min middleware. GET /api/admin/panel/security as admin returns {stats:{rpm,blocked_today,waf_hits,bans_total,banned_now,tracked_ips,attack_mode}, events:[50], bans:[]} — verified via curl + browser. Frontend (desktop 1920x1080): admin logs into /secret-mod and mod-tab-security tab renders all 6 stat cards (sec-rpm, sec-blocked, sec-waf, sec-bans, sec-bans-total, sec-attack), mod-sec-events populated with 50 rows (currently rate_auth events from this test session), mod-sec-bans container hidden since no active bans and 'Nicio blocare activă — trafic curat' empty-state shown — correct. Public pages regression: / shows noutati-page+hero-live-badge+home-clips+home-tracks with 0 console errors; /tv shows tv-stage+tv-bigplay+tv-guide+tv-chat with 0 console errors; /muzica audio.paused=True (no autoplay); /clipuri renders. Mobile 375px: / and /tv scrollWidth==clientWidth, no horizontal overflow. Overall success: backend 20/20 (100%), frontend 100% of in-scope flows.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' for mod-sec-events rows (sample id 'se_1793388880235_.0.0.1'). Backend's security.py event-id generation can produce colliding ids when many events share the same timestamp+last-octet; the UI then keys by e.id and duplicates. Non-blocking (events still render) but noisy and could drop a row.

action_items: Optional (LOW): make security_events id globally unique in security.py (e.g., add uuid4 or a monotonic counter) so React keys on mod-sec-events never collide; alternatively key by (e.id + idx) in SecretMod.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py middleware correctly layers probe-path 403 + scanner UA 403 + payload signatures 400 + body cap 413 + per-endpoint anti-spam 429 + global 120/min + strict auth 10 POST/min — all 11 regression tests green.

Loopback exemption works as designed: WAF tests via localhost:8001 never ban, so pytest reruns are safe. Shared preview-ingress egress IP (35.193.209.116) accumulates auth strikes — tests must space ~60s apart as noted.
Admin security endpoint stats match live counters (rpm=14, blocked_today=42, waf_hits=12 observed) and events journal does not leak passwords/tokens/bodies — verified by curl inspection.
Account system is 100% untouched — admin login (cristimf2007@gmail.com) + fan login lockout + register throttle + /auth/me and /fans/me graceful 200{user:null} all still pass unchanged.
Minor nit: event ids like 'se_<ts>_<ip-tail>' may collide (duplicate React keys). Harmless for stats but visible in console; fix is one-line (append uuid4 hex or array index).

rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate-key React warning on Securitate events list — root cause: security.py builds event ids from timestamp+partial IP, which can collide when multiple events in the same request get the same ts+suffix. Mitigation: append uuid4().hex[:6] to the id, or in SecretMod.jsx key the map by `${e.id}-${idx}`. Non-blocking.
